faqs.q: What is the DEMCO 10-position locking handle for butterfly valves used for?
faqs.a: The DEMCO 10-position locking handle is a manual lever for 2″ to 12″ DEMCO butterfly valves that locks the disc at ten positions between closed and open. It allows flow throttling at fixed positions, with a positive latch at every detent.

faqs.q: Which valve sizes does the DEMCO 10-position handle fit?
faqs.a: It comes in three frame sizes, 2″–4″ (small), 5″–6″ (medium) and 8″–12″ (large), matched to the valve size. It mounts directly on the DEMCO top flange via the flatted double-D upper stem, with no adapter.

faqs.q: Which DEMCO butterfly valves is the 10-position handle compatible with?
faqs.a: It fits NE-C, NE-I, NE-I Sanitary, NE-D and NEI-T valves, which is any 2″–12″ DEMCO butterfly valve, such as the [NE-C wafer valve in 4″](/p/demco-series-ne-c-wafer-butterfly-valve-4-inch-200-psi). With the optional utility-top stem it also fits competitive valves.

faqs.q: What trim levels and materials does the 10-position handle come in?
faqs.a: Three trim levels: standard (zinc-plated steel parts on a ductile-iron handle), corrosion-resistant (stainless throughout) and sanitary (bronze hub with stainless fasteners for caustic wash-down). State the trim when you order; stainless trim suits marine and wash-down service.

faqs.q: How much torque can the 10-position handle deliver?
faqs.a: The listing does not give a torque figure; it says the lever is hand-operable across the 2″–6″ range and recommends a gear operator for 8″–12″. For 8″ and larger valves see the [DEMCO worm-gear operator](/p/demco-worm-gear-operator-for-butterfly-valves-2-36).

faqs.q: 10-position handle or 2-position handle: which one should I choose?
faqs.a: Choose the 10-position handle where you need to throttle flow at fixed positions, and the [2-position handle](/p/demco-2-position-locking-handle-for-butterfly-valves-2-12) for on/off duty only. With 2 detents the operator cannot leave the valve part-open by mistake.

faqs.q: Can the 10-position handle be padlocked for lockout?
faqs.a: Yes. The handle has a 0.25″ padlock hole for security lockout and the latch holds each detent so the handle cannot drift under flow forces. It suits lockout/tagout safety isolation.

faqs.q: What are typical uses of the DEMCO 10-position locking handle?
faqs.a: Typical uses are general industrial isolation and throttling, process plant manual flow control, marine and offshore valve operation with the stainless trim, and food and beverage utility lines with the sanitary trim.

faqs.q: Can the 10-position handle be fitted to a valve already in service?
faqs.a: Yes. DEMCO valve actuation is field-changeable through the top-flange standard, so the handle mounts directly to the flatted double-D stem of a compatible valve. Specify the valve series and size and the trim level when you ask for a quote.

faqs.q: What is the environmental rating of the DEMCO 10-position handle?
faqs.a: It is outdoor-rated, and the stainless-steel trim is for marine and wash-down service. The listing gives no IP or NEMA rating for the handle, so state any chemical exposure or temperature on the enquiry.

faqs.q: Where is the DEMCO 10-position handle made and how long does it take?
faqs.a: The DEMCO 10-position handle is listed with the USA as its country of origin and is typically dispatched within 14 working days. We export from Dubai, UAE to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond; give the destination for the invoice and origin papers.

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO 2-position locking handle for butterfly valves used for?
faqs.a: The DEMCO 2-position locking handle is a manual lever for 2″ to 12″ DEMCO butterfly valves that locks only at full-closed and full-open. It is chosen for on/off isolation where an intermediate position would risk operator-induced throttling.

faqs.q: Which valve sizes does the DEMCO 2-position handle fit?
faqs.a: It comes in the same three frame sizes as the other lever handles, 2″–4″, 5″–6″ and 8″–12″, matched to the valve size. It mounts directly on the DEMCO top flange via the flatted double-D stem.

faqs.q: Which DEMCO butterfly valves is the 2-position handle compatible with?
faqs.a: It fits NE-C, NE-I, NE-I Sanitary, NE-D and NEI-T valves, which is any 2″–12″ DEMCO butterfly valve, for example the [NE-I wafer valve in 4″](/p/demco-series-ne-i-wafer-butterfly-valve-4-inch-200-psi).

faqs.q: What trim levels does the DEMCO 2-position handle come in?
faqs.a: Three: standard (zinc-plated steel), corrosion-resistant (stainless throughout) and sanitary (bronze hub with stainless fasteners). It has the same construction as the 10-position handle but with a 2-position throttle plate instead of a 10-detent plate.

faqs.q: 2-position handle or 10-position handle: what is the difference?
faqs.a: The 2-position handle locks only at closed (0°) and open (90°), so it cannot throttle, while the [10-position handle](/p/demco-10-position-locking-handle-for-butterfly-valves-2-12) has ten intermediate detents. Pick the 2-position handle where throttling must be physically prevented.

faqs.q: How much torque can the 2-position handle deliver?
faqs.a: The listing gives no torque figure; the lever is hand-operable across the 2″–6″ range, and a gear operator is recommended for 8″–12″. See the [DEMCO worm-gear operator](/p/demco-worm-gear-operator-for-butterfly-valves-2-36) for larger valves.

faqs.q: Can the 2-position handle be padlocked?
faqs.a: Yes. It has a 0.25″ padlock hole for lockout, and the latch engages positively at each end position. That suits safety-shutdown manual block valves.

faqs.q: Where is the DEMCO 2-position handle used?
faqs.a: Typical uses are critical on/off isolation where throttling must be prevented, pump suction and discharge isolation, tank-farm bulk-loading lines, safety-shutdown manual block valves and loadout and offloading block service.

faqs.q: Is the DEMCO 2-position handle outdoor-rated?
faqs.a: Yes, it is outdoor-rated, with a stainless trim for marine and wash-down service. The listing gives no IP or NEMA rating, so state any chemical exposure on the enquiry.

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO memory-stop throttling handle for butterfly valves used for?
faqs.a: The DEMCO memory-stop throttling handle gives infinitely adjustable manual throttling between closed and open, with a lock-nut stop that holds a preset open position. It is used for manual flow balancing in branch lines and hose stations.

faqs.q: Which valve sizes does the DEMCO memory-stop handle fit?
faqs.a: It comes in three frame sizes, 2″–4″, 5″–6″ and 8″–12″, for any 2″–12″ DEMCO butterfly valve. It mounts directly on the DEMCO top flange.

faqs.q: How do you set the memory stop on the DEMCO throttling handle?
faqs.a: Loosen the wing nut, turn the handle to the throttle position you want and tighten the wing nut again. The valve can then be closed and reopened to the memory stop without resetting, and the adjustment is done in service without removing the handle.

faqs.q: Memory-stop handle or 10-position handle for throttling?
faqs.a: The memory-stop handle is infinitely adjustable between 0° and 90° and returns to a preset open position, while the [10-position handle](/p/demco-10-position-locking-handle-for-butterfly-valves-2-12) throttles only at ten fixed detents. Use the memory stop where the same open position must be repeated.

faqs.q: What trim levels does the memory-stop handle come in?
faqs.a: Three trim levels: standard, corrosion-resistant (stainless) and sanitary (bronze hub with stainless fasteners). State the trim and the frame size matching your valve when you order.

faqs.q: Which DEMCO butterfly valves fit the memory-stop handle?
faqs.a: It fits NE-C, NE-I, NE-I Sanitary, NE-D and NEI-T valves in 2″–12″, for example the [NE-D wafer valve in 4″](/p/demco-series-ne-d-wafer-butterfly-valve-4-inch-200-psi), through the DEMCO top flange and its double-D stem.

faqs.q: Where is the DEMCO memory-stop handle used?
faqs.a: Typical uses are manual flow balancing on branch lines, hose-station and wash-down outlets needing repeatable flow, process trim adjustment, building HVAC balancing and cooling-water flow trim.

faqs.q: What is the torque rating of the memory-stop handle?
faqs.a: The listing gives no torque figure; it is hand-operable across 2″–6″ and a gear operator is recommended for 8″–12″. See the [worm-gear operator](/p/demco-worm-gear-operator-for-butterfly-valves-2-36).

faqs.q: Is the memory-stop handle outdoor-rated?
faqs.a: Yes, it is outdoor-rated, with a stainless trim for marine and wash-down service. The listing gives no IP or NEMA rating.

faqs.q: Does the memory-stop handle need special tools to recalibrate?
faqs.a: No. The throttle plate uses a carriage bolt and wing nut, so the memory stop is recalibrated without tools. It is one of the tool-free adjustments the design is built for.

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO Series DR double-acting pneumatic actuator used for?
faqs.a: The DEMCO Series DR double-acting actuator turns a 2″ to 24″ butterfly valve through 90° using air or hydraulic pressure on either side of two opposed pistons. It is the most economical Series DR variant and leaves the valve in its last position if supply is lost.

faqs.q: Which frame sizes and torques does the Series DR double-acting actuator come in?
faqs.a: It comes in ten frame sizes from EDA40 to PDA4000. Listed torques run from 620 in-lb for the EDA40 at 120 psi, 3,071 in-lb for the EDA200 and 22,379 in-lb for the EDA1600, up to 60,623 in-lb for the PDA4000.

faqs.q: What supply pressure does the DEMCO DR double-acting actuator need?
faqs.a: It runs on 40 to 120 psi air or hydraulic supply, in steps of 40, 60, 80, 100 or 120 psi. Specify the supply pressure so the actuator is sized against the valve's wet-opening torque table.

faqs.q: Which DEMCO valves does the Series DR double-acting actuator fit?
faqs.a: It fits NE-C, NE-I, NE-D and NF-C valves from 2″ to 24″, mounted directly through a splined aluminium stem adapter on 2″–12″ valves and a keyed stem on 14″–24″ NF-C valves. See the [NE-C 4″ wafer valve](/p/demco-series-ne-c-wafer-butterfly-valve-4-inch-200-psi) for an example.

faqs.q: What is the DR double-acting actuator made of?
faqs.a: The body, pistons and end caps are aluminium, and the central drive shaft is hard-anodised Aluminium Alloy 70-75. Seals are Buna-N, fasteners are plated steel, and carbon-filled Teflon guide bands carry the pistons.

faqs.q: DR double-acting or spring-return actuator: which should I choose?
faqs.a: The double-acting actuator needs pressure to move the valve in both directions and fails in the last position, while the [spring-return actuator](/p/demco-series-dr-spring-return-pneumatic-actuator-for-butterfly-valves-2-24) drives the valve to a safe position on loss of air. Use spring-return for shutdown duty.

faqs.q: How is a DR double-acting actuator specified for a valve?
faqs.a: Give the valve series and size, the supply medium and pressure, and the orientation of the flow axis relative to the actuator body. We size it against the valve's wet-opening torque table; the part number suffix encodes valve size, orientation and accessories.

faqs.q: What enclosure rating does the Series DR actuator have?
faqs.a: It is totally enclosed with gaskets, giving a weatherproof body, and NEMA 4 or NEMA 7 enclosures are available for accessories. The listing gives no other rating for the actuator.

faqs.q: Can the DR double-acting actuator be fitted to an existing manual valve?
faqs.a: Yes. The top-flange standard makes DEMCO valve actuation field-changeable, so the actuator mounts directly or through an adapter plate or bracket kit on the largest valves.

faqs.q: Where is the DEMCO DR double-acting actuator used?
faqs.a: It is used on automated installations of 2″ to 24″ DEMCO butterfly valves for remote on/off or modulating service where a fail-last-position action is acceptable.

faqs.q: Where is the DEMCO DR actuator made and how long does it take?
faqs.a: The DEMCO DR actuator is listed with the USA as its country of origin and is typically dispatched within 14 working days. We export from Dubai, UAE to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond; give the destination for the invoice and origin papers.

faqs.a: Typically dispatched within 14 working days. Send the valve series and size, the supply pressure and the orientation through [our contact page](/contact) and we return an estimate.

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO Series DR spring-return pneumatic actuator used for?
faqs.a: The DEMCO Series DR spring-return actuator turns a 2″ to 24″ butterfly valve with air pressure against compression springs, so on loss of air the springs drive the valve to a fail-open or fail-closed position. It is the standard choice for emergency shutdown, blow-down and fire-water valves.

faqs.q: Which frame sizes and spring sets does the Series DR spring-return actuator come in?
faqs.a: It comes from ESA40 to PSA4004, with spring sets 2–6 on ESA40–ESA1600 and sets 8–14 on PSA2500–PSA4004. We recommend the spring set against the valve's wet-opening torque.

faqs.q: What supply pressure does the DR spring-return actuator need?
faqs.a: It runs on 40 to 120 psi air, in steps of 40, 60, 80, 100 or 120 psi. The listed torques include 322 in-lb for the ESA40 spring-set 5 at 120 psi and 47,613 in-lb for the PSA4000.

faqs.q: Which DEMCO valves does the Series DR spring-return actuator fit?
faqs.a: It fits NE-C, NE-I, NE-D and NF-C valves from 2″ to 24″, mounted directly on a splined stem for 2″–12″ or a keyed stem for 14″–24″, for example the [NE-I 6″ wafer valve](/p/demco-series-ne-i-wafer-butterfly-valve-6-inch-200-psi).

faqs.q: What is the DR spring-return actuator made of?
faqs.a: The body, pistons and end caps are aluminium with a hard-anodised drive shaft, compression springs sized to the application, plated-steel fasteners and Buna-N seals.

faqs.q: DR spring-return or double-acting actuator: which should I choose?
faqs.a: Choose spring-return where loss of air must drive the valve to a defined position, and the [double-acting actuator](/p/demco-series-dr-double-acting-pneumatic-actuator-for-butterfly-valves-2-24) where the valve may stay in its last position. Spring-return costs more but is the fail-safe choice.

faqs.q: What does fail-open or fail-closed mean on a spring-return actuator?
faqs.a: It is the position the spring drives the valve to when supply air is lost. The fail position depends on the spring orientation, so state it when you order.

faqs.q: Can the DR spring-return actuator have a manual override?
faqs.a: Yes. A declutchable manual override is available across the range, from size 40 to 4004, so a handwheel can hold the valve in its last position until the actuator returns to automatic. Explosion-proof solenoids and position switches to NEMA 7 can be specified.

faqs.q: Where is the DEMCO spring-return actuator used?
faqs.a: It is used on emergency shutdown valves, blow-down lines, fire-water valves and any application where loss of control air must drive the valve to a defined position.

faqs.q: How is a DR spring-return actuator specified?
faqs.a: Give the valve series and size, the supply pressure, the fail position and the spring set. We size the actuator against the valve's wet-opening torque table before we quote.

faqs.q: Where is the DEMCO DR spring-return actuator made and how long does it take?
faqs.a: The DEMCO DR spring-return actuator is listed with the USA as its country of origin and is typically dispatched within 14 working days. We export from Dubai, UAE to the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond; give the destination for the invoice and origin papers.

faqs.a: Typically dispatched within 14 working days. Send the valve series and size, the supply pressure and the fail position through [our contact page](/contact) and we return an estimate.

faqs.q: What is the DEMCO Series NE-C general-purpose butterfly valve used for?
faqs.a: The DEMCO Series NE-C is a long-neck, resilient-seated butterfly valve for 2″ to 12″ lines, in wafer and lug bodies. The long neck clears two inches of insulation on ASME Class 150 flanges, making it the default choice for insulated and steam-jacketed process lines.

faqs.q: Which sizes and body styles does the DEMCO NE-C come in?
faqs.a: It comes in 2″ through 12″ (50 – 300 mm), in wafer and lug bodies, with ASME Class 125/150 flange connections. The size-specific pages, such as the [4″ NE-C wafer valve](/p/demco-series-ne-c-wafer-butterfly-valve-4-inch-200-psi), list the factory trims in stock.

faqs.q: What shut-off ratings does the DEMCO NE-C have?
faqs.a: Three drop-tight ratings: 200 psi standard, 285 psi high-pressure and 50 psi low-torque, plus a throttling option. The body is rated ASME Class 150 at 285 psi non-shock, and the valve seals against vacuum down to 10 microns.

faqs.q: What temperature range does the DEMCO NE-C cover?
faqs.a: The range is −30°F to +300°F (−34°C to +149°C), depending on the seat elastomer. Choose Buna-N, EPDM, Viton or another seat to suit the fluid and temperature.

faqs.q: What materials does the DEMCO NE-C come in?
faqs.a: Body materials include cast iron (wafer), ductile iron (lug), aluminium bronze, carbon steel (WCB), aluminium, nickel-plated ductile iron, 316 stainless steel (CF8M) and PVF-coated ductile iron. Stems are 416 stainless, 316 stainless or Monel, and seats include Buna-N, Viton and EPDM.

faqs.q: What is the flow coefficient of the DEMCO NE-C?
faqs.a: The Cv at 90° open runs from 145 for the 2″ to 7,500 for the 12″. Use the Cv for the size you choose when you work out pressure drop.

faqs.q: DEMCO NE-C or NE-I butterfly valve: what is the difference?
faqs.a: The NE-C has a long neck that clears two inches of insulation, while the [NE-I short-neck valve](/p/demco-series-ne-i-short-neck-butterfly-valve-2-12) is the standard-installation version with the widest range of body materials. Use the NE-C on lagged piping.

faqs.q: Can the DEMCO NE-C be used for end-of-line service?
faqs.a: Yes, in the lug body: it can isolate the end of a line with the downstream piping removed, using weld-neck or socket flanges only. The wafer body cannot.

faqs.q: Which operators fit the DEMCO NE-C?
faqs.a: Lever handles (10-position, 2-position, memory-stop, square nut), weatherproof worm-gear operators and Series DR double-acting and spring-return pneumatic actuators. See the [10-position handle](/p/demco-10-position-locking-handle-for-butterfly-valves-2-12) and the [DR actuators](/p/demco-series-dr-double-acting-pneumatic-actuator-for-butterfly-valves-2-24).

faqs.q: Is the DEMCO NE-C fire-safe or NACE rated?
faqs.a: No. DEMCO NE-series valves are resilient-seated process butterfly valves without API 607 fire-safe or NACE MR0175 certification. Choose a metal-seated valve where those are required.

faqs.q: What is the 12″ DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve rated 200 psi used for?
faqs.a: The 12″ (300 mm) DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve is a resilient-seated long-neck, general-purpose valve whose neck clears two inches of insulation on ASME Class 150 pipe flanges. It gives 200 psi drop-tight, bi-directional shut-off in an ASME Class 150 body, for general process lines.

faqs.q: How do I read DEMCO part number J022127-5114311 on the 12″ NE-C lug valve?
faqs.a: In J022127-5114311, J022127 is the DEMCO base number for a 12″ Series NE-C valve at 200 psi. The suffix reads left to right: body configuration (5 = lug), body material (1 = ductile iron), stem (1 = 416 stainless steel), disc (4 = aluminium bronze) and seat (31 = Buna-N). The last character is the operator code. See [DEMCO butterfly valve part numbers decoded](/blog/demco-butterfly-valve-part-numbers).

faqs.q: Which configurations of the 12″ DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve can Indus supply?
faqs.a: 3 factory configurations are listed, from J022127-5114311 to J022127-5122341. Bodies are ductile iron, discs aluminium bronze and 316 stainless steel and seats Buna-N and Viton (FKM).

faqs.q: What are the body, disc and seat materials of the 12″ DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve?
faqs.a: In the 12″ NE-C lug valve the body is ductile iron; the disc is aluminium bronze and 316 stainless steel; the stem is 416 stainless steel and 316 stainless steel; and the seat is Buna-N and Viton (FKM). The seat is a hard-backed cartridge, bonded to a rigid ring so it can be replaced in the field without special tools.

faqs.q: What pressure does the 12″ DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve hold?
faqs.a: The 12″ NE-C lug valve, for example J022127-5114311, is rated 200 psi drop-tight, identical from either flow direction, in an ASME Class 150 body with a 285 psi non-shock body rating. It seals against vacuum down to 10 microns (29.9 in Hg).

faqs.q: What temperature range does the 12″ DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve cover?
faqs.a: For this 12″ NE-C lug valve the range depends on the seat: Buna-N seat 0°F to +180°F (−18°C to +82°C); Viton (FKM) seat +20°F to +300°F (−7°C to +149°C). Match the elastomer to the fluid and temperature; Buna-N is the general oil and hydrocarbon seat, and Viton is the high-temperature chemical seat.

faqs.q: Which flange standard and marking apply to the 12″ DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve?
faqs.a: The 12″ NE-C fits between ASME Class 125/150 flanges, raised- or flat-face, and every valve carries MSS SP-25 marking. DEMCO NE-series valves carry no API 607 fire-safe or NACE MR0175 certification, so ask for a metal-seated valve where those are required.

faqs.q: Can the 12″ DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve be used as an end-of-line valve?
faqs.a: Yes. The lug body has threaded bolt holes, so the 12″ NE-C valve can stay in service as an end-of-line isolator in liquid service up to 200 psi, with a blind flange attached and the downstream pipe removed. Use weld-neck or socket flanges upstream; slip-on and threaded flanges are not supported.

faqs.q: Which operators fit the 12″ DEMCO NE-C lug butterfly valve?
faqs.a: The DEMCO top flange on the 12″ NE-C lug valve takes the [10-position locking handle](/p/demco-10-position-locking-handle-for-butterfly-valves-2-12), the [worm-gear operator](/p/demco-worm-gear-operator-for-butterfly-valves-2-36) and the [Series DR pneumatic actuators](/p/demco-series-dr-double-acting-pneumatic-actuator-for-butterfly-valves-2-24), so it can be automated later. DEMCO recommends a worm-gear operator at 8 inch and larger. Confirm the operator supplied with each part number when we quote.

faqs.q: 12″ NE-C lug or wafer butterfly valve: what is the difference?
faqs.a: The lug body has threaded bolt holes for end-of-line service, while the [wafer body](/p/demco-series-ne-c-wafer-butterfly-valve-12-inch-200-psi) is clamped on through-bolts and cannot hold pressure with a flange removed. Both are rated 200 psi drop-tight in the NE-C 12″ size.
